scope_notes: We check rain, heat, cold, snow, wind and recent rain. We don't yet check thunderstorms, hail, freezing rain or ice, wildfire, air quality, coastal flooding, or geological hazards. For those, follow official warnings.
Thunderstorms are not checked. Storms are a major cause of weather deaths — follow official storm warnings.
The history data is a ~25 km grid and misses very local storms.
Groundtruth covers weather-driven hazards only. For landslides, glacier collapse or earthquakes, check local civil protection and geological authorities.

reply.headline: Typical rain, temperature, snow and wind for Paris, France on 7 Jan 2026.
why: Every check we ran, including rain, feels-like heat and cold, snow, wind and rain over the last 6 days, fell in the usual range here.
Snowfall is 3.0 cm over 24 h: normal snowfall for here, and days like this happen about 1.1 times a year now.
Gusts up to 36 km/h are normal wind for here, and days like this happen about 172 times a year now.

Feels-like cold of -6.5 °C is normal lows for here; days like this happen about 12 times a year now versus about 19 times a year in 1951–1980, which does not make the day any less serious, because the level is based on the recent 30 years.
reply.what_it_means: The checks do not cover thunderstorms, freezing rain or ice on roads, or geological hazards such as landslides or glacier collapse, so those risks are not ruled out by this result. Plan your day with that in mind. Check your official weather warnings, because Groundtruth never replaces them.
